Class Toggle

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.toggle.Toggle
All Implemented Interfaces:
StatefulWidget<ToggleState>
public final class Toggle extends Object implements StatefulWidget<ToggleState>
A toggle switch widget that displays an on/off state.

Supports two display modes:

  • Single symbol mode (default): Shows one symbol at a time, e.g., "[ON ]" or "[OFF]"
  • Inline choice mode: Shows both options with indicators, e.g., "● Yes / ○ No"
// Single symbol mode (default)
Toggle toggle = Toggle.builder().build();  // [ON ] or [OFF]

// Custom single symbols
Toggle toggle = Toggle.builder()
    .onSymbol("◉ ON ")
    .offSymbol("○ OFF")
    .onColor(Color.GREEN)
    .build();

// Inline choice mode: ● Yes / ○ No
Toggle toggle = Toggle.builder()
    .inlineChoice(true)
    .onLabel("Yes")
    .offLabel("No")
    .selectedIndicator("●")
    .unselectedIndicator("○")
    .selectedColor(Color.GREEN)
    .unselectedColor(Color.DARK_GRAY)
    .build();

CSS Properties

  • toggle-on-symbol - Symbol when on (single mode, default: "[ON ]")
  • toggle-off-symbol - Symbol when off (single mode, default: "[OFF]")
  • toggle-on-color - Foreground color when on
  • toggle-off-color - Foreground color when off
  • toggle-selected-indicator - Indicator for selected option (inline mode, default: "●")
  • toggle-unselected-indicator - Indicator for unselected option (inline mode, default: "○")
  • toggle-selected-color - Color for selected option indicator
  • toggle-unselected-color - Color for unselected option indicator
